focused_wrapper_source:
param([string]$RepositoryRoot,[string]$WorkRoot,[string]$TestPython,[string]$ReportPath)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$RepositoryRoot=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepositoryRoot).ProviderPath
$TestPython=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $TestPython).ProviderPath
$null=New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $WorkRoot
Set-Location -LiteralPath $WorkRoot
Import-Module '<USERPROFILE>\AppData\Local\Temp\WinBookSplit-v103-tools-dba854774368479bb05315d8084591f4\Pester\6.2.0\Pester.psd1' -Force
$sourcePaths=@('engine\WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1','engine\WinBookSplit.Process.ps1','WinBookSplit.ps1','tests\powershell\Discovery.Tests.ps1','tests\powershell\Manager.Tests.ps1','tests\powershell\Runtime.Tests.ps1','tests\powershell\Process.Tests.ps1')
$before=@($sourcePaths | ForEach-Object {[ordered]@{path=$_;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepositoryRoot $_) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}})
$config=New-PesterConfiguration
$config.Run.Container=@(foreach ($name in @('Manager','Discovery','Runtime','Process')) {
    New-PesterContainer -Path (Join-Path $RepositoryRoot ('tests\powershell\'+$name+'.Tests.ps1')) -Data @{RepositoryRoot=$RepositoryRoot;WorkRoot=$WorkRoot;TestPython=$TestPython}
})
$config.Run.PassThru=$true
$config.Output.Verbosity='Detailed'
$result=Invoke-Pester -Configuration $config
$after=@($sourcePaths | ForEach-Object {[ordered]@{path=$_;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepositoryRoot $_) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}})
$unchanged=($before | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) -ceq ($after | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
[ordered]@{schema_version=1;purpose='T03 focused maintained contracts; synthetic seams labelled in test names/comments. Actual children are isolated developer Python regression, not owner Store acceptance.';shell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();execution_policy=(Get-ExecutionPolicy);test_python=$TestPython;passed=$result.PassedCount;failed=$result.FailedCount;skipped=$result.SkippedCount;source_unchanged=$unchanged;source_before=$before;source_after=$after;tests=@($result.Tests | ForEach-Object {[ordered]@{name=$_.ExpandedName;result=[string]$_.Result;errors=@($_.ErrorRecord | ForEach-Object {$_.ToString()})}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 9 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $ReportPath -Encoding utf8
if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or -not $unchanged) {exit 1}
preservation: No desktop Python/Manager install/update, PATH/alias change, owner/checkout app venv creation, source-ZIP installation change, private-document processing, old record/release mutation or early publication. Owned disposable developer test venvs only.
